title: Full-support sampling and soft topographical ordering
objective: Compare IID, Sobol and randomized Sobol proposal streams and test a soft k-nearest-neighbor ordering without sacrificing the permanent full-support lane.
hypothesis: Owen-scrambled Sobol and soft topographical ordering can improve finite-budget all-target recall, while a nonvanishing IID lane preserves the simple conditional capture guarantee and close-root insurance.

included: all-launch IID, Sobol and randomized Sobol streams
soft k-nearest-neighbor ordering with deferred starts

literature.claim: Sobol sequences provide low-discrepancy coverage of a bounded cube.
literature.assumptions: A bounded box and useful low-dimensional projections.
literature.break_conditions: Basin geometry is misaligned or deterministic prefixes cannot support seed-wise uncertainty.

literature.claim: Owen scrambling randomizes digital nets while retaining equidistribution properties.
literature.assumptions: The paper's formal performance results concern integration of measurable square-integrable functions.
literature.break_conditions: Root-basin hitting is not an integration-error theorem and points within a scramble are dependent.

literature.claim: Topographical initialization uses Sobol samples and a nearest-neighbor graph to choose local starts for constrained nonlinear systems.
literature.assumptions: The residual landscape and bounded sampling region expose useful graph minima.
literature.break_conditions: Close roots, narrow basins, invalid domains and positive-residual minima.

literature.claim: APOSMM analyzes asynchronous multistart under finite-minimum and regularity assumptions.
literature.assumptions: Compact domain with finitely many suitably separated minima.
literature.break_conditions: Close roots, zero manifolds, nonzero minima and several configurations sharing a target.

literature.claim: Anytime empirical runtime distributions compare black-box algorithms at fixed targets and costs.
literature.assumptions: Targets, cost accounting and instances are fixed before observing results.
literature.break_conditions: Best-seed reporting, ignored screening cost or post-hoc truth thresholds.

controls.description: IID uniform starts launched in generation order with no screening or suppression.
Deterministic Sobol starts with every point launched and no ranking.
Launch only the lowest screening residuals to reproduce the known selection failure before permanent rejection.

candidates.description: Independently Owen-scrambled Sobol blocks with every point launched.
Fixed interleave of IID insurance and randomized Sobol starts, all launched.
Mixed stream with graph minima launched first and every other screened start kept in an aging deferred queue.

synthetic_families.purpose: Generate an analytic finite root set with independently varied dimension, root separation and conditioning.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic roots of p(z1) with dependent coordinates h_i(z1)

synthetic_families.purpose: Separate configuration coverage from distinct target-value coverage.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic target map on ROOT-CURVE roots

synthetic_families.purpose: Check unknown compositions of line, circle, distance and projection primitives without selector ties.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic construction with independently checked target values

real_problem_policy: Use only independently audited Gold development problems. Unknown composition and family groups must remain disjoint between tuning and locked validation.

execution_order: Compare D0, D1, D2 and D3 using launch-prefix checkpoints
Tune the IID fraction once on development families and freeze it
Compare FIFO with D4 soft ordering using the selected sample source
design.pairing: Variants share generator instances, budget checkpoints and local policy; randomized variants use common seed namespaces and stored proposals where mathematically applicable.
design.freeze_rule: Sample mix, screening block and k rule freeze before locked validation; D0 remains a permanent control regardless of outcome.
design.locked_validation_rule: Any inspected locked miss burns that family set; no hyperparameter changes are evaluated on the same locked set.
notes: Each locked randomized variant uses 30 seeds.
A single 128-launch trace supplies all smaller prefix checkpoints.
The IID capture bound is attached only to IID starts, not to dependent scrambled-net points.

proposal_batch_size.rationale: Matches the minimal event-loop control and permits prefix accounting.
proposal_batch_size.freeze_rule: Keep fixed for Stage A; tune only before Stage B if screening overhead requires it.

iid_fraction.rationale: Prior counterexamples indicate a material independent insurance stream is needed.
iid_fraction.freeze_rule: One development comparison, then freeze; never allow zero in a production candidate.

screening_block_formula.rationale: Keeps graph construction bounded while scaling with dimension.
screening_block_formula.freeze_rule: Choose from development overhead and recall before locked validation.

knn_formula.rationale: A simple dimension-independent soft-topograph neighborhood without adding a package dependency.
knn_formula.freeze_rule: At most one development comparison; no locked retuning.

iid_launch_cadence.rationale: Guarantees at least one raw IID launch in every four candidate launches.
iid_launch_cadence.freeze_rule: Derived from the frozen IID fraction and audited mechanically.

deferred_launches_per_wave.rationale: Prevents screened non-minima from starving indefinitely.
deferred_launches_per_wave.freeze_rule: May increase for fairness but may never be zero.

budgets.accounting: Charge sampling, screening, k-nearest-neighbor construction, every local attempt and canonical validation to both wall and oracle-work totals.

seeds.generation: Generator, IID and scramble seeds use separate namespaces; proposal blocks or checksums are persisted for replay.

primary.definition: Fraction of runs recovering every distinct Gold target with no extra accepted target at a fixed prefix or wall budget.

secondary.definition: End-to-end wall time through the first prefix containing all Gold targets.
Primal-equivalent oracle work through the first all-target prefix.
Local successes whose target was already represented by a valid witness.
Sampling, residual screening and graph-ordering time divided by end-to-end time.

safety.definition: Accepted targets outside independently audited Gold truth.
Prefixes violating the frozen minimum raw IID cadence.
Finite queued proposals bypassed contrary to the declared aging rule.

criteria: False target, IID fairness and deferred starvation counts are zero.
The candidate improves P_full_target by at least 5 percentage points or reduces time/oracle work by at least 20 percent at equal P_full_target.
No critical close-root, close-target or conditioning stratum loses more than 2 P_full_target points.
Screening and ordering overhead is at most 10 percent on unrelated strata.
The effect repeats in at least three unrelated families with a paired family-clustered 95 percent confidence interval on the improvement side.
If candidates remain within 5 percent of D0 on recall and cost, D0 is selected.
A candidate permanently discards a start or sets the independent lane to zero.
A finite deferred proposal can starve under the implemented schedule.
Close-root or close-target P_full_target drops by more than 2 points.
Screening cost makes the candidate slower at the same launch and wall budget.
The effect fails to reproduce across seed, dimension or family after two tuning rounds.
Soft ordering remains within 5 percent of FIFO, in which case its production code is removed.

safety_invariants: The independent full-support lane satisfies N_independent(t) tending to infinity.
Target values of far infeasible screening points never suppress discovery.
Every local endpoint is checked by the canonical oracle.
Search exhaustion remains unknown and never certifies emptiness or completeness.
Production routing uses measured structure and progress, never problem identity.
